entries.name: KLAVIYO_PRIVATE_API_KEY
entries.description: A Klaviyo private API key with read-only scopes, for profiles, lists, segments, campaigns, flows and their figures. Klaviyo can't be asked which scopes a key holds, so the connector can't check it; it only sends its listed reads whatever the key allows.
howToGet: In Klaviyo, open Settings > Account > API keys (an Owner, Admin or Manager can) and choose Create Private API Key. Name it KaratOS.

Choose Custom Key and give Read Access to Profiles, Lists, Segments, Campaigns, Flows and Metrics, and No Access to everything else. Never pick Full Access Key, and never reuse an old key: keys made before scopes existed have full access.
Copy the key (pk_...) straight into the host's secret store. Klaviyo shows it once.

entries.name: KLAVIYO_CONVERSION_METRIC_ID
entries.description: Optional. The id of the metric the campaign and flow reports count conversions and revenue by. Empty means the metric named Placed Order, which Klaviyo's own reports use.
howToGet: Leave empty unless the store records orders under another metric. To find one, open Analytics > Metrics in Klaviyo, open the metric and copy the id from the page address.

entries.name: KLAVIYO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: Secret of a Klaviyo system webhook, which signs each delivery (Klaviyo-Signature over the body and Klaviyo-Timestamp). Only Advanced KDP customers and Klaviyo app partners can create webhooks; the scheduled sync works without them.
howToGet: Only if the account has webhooks: create the webhook with the Webhooks API, choosing your own random secret_key, and put the same value in the host's secret store.
